profile.reading: CoreSite traces to 2001, when it was founded as CRG West, a Carlyle Group portfolio company, before rebranding as CoreSite in 2009. American Tower Corporation, the public tower and infrastructure company trading as AMT, SEC filer CIK 1053507, completed its acquisition of CoreSite in late 2021. Stonepeak Partners LP later bought into American Towers US data center business directly, acquiring roughly 29 percent in July 2022 and increasing that stake to about 36 percent by October 2022. CoreSites own site describes a portfolio of 30 data centers across 11 US markets, Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Denver, Los Angeles, Miami, New York, Northern Virginia, Orlando, Raleigh, Silicon Valley, and Washington DC, totaling more than 4.8 million square feet, with more than 44,000 customer interconnections and 500 or more connected network providers. This specific building, BO1, is CoreSites Boston market facility. CoreSites own current Boston regional page and a separate dedicated operator spec sheet page for this building (both tier-1 operator sources) agree its address is 70 Inner Belt Road, Somerville, MA 02143. The dedicated BO1 spec sheet gives 253,000 square feet, the operators separate Boston regional overview page instead rounds to 273,000 plus square feet, since both are the operators own pages and the two figures differ, this discrepancy is noted rather than silently resolved, 253,000 is treated as the more precise, building dedicated figure. No MW or power capacity figure is published, the operators own spec sheet states that power specifics are available only by contacting CoreSite directly.
